name: MISAKO & ROSEN
about_text: Misako & Rosen is a contemporary art gallery in Tokyo's Otsuka neighborhood, founded in 2006 by Misako Rosen and Jeffrey Rosen with a solo exhibition by Shimon Minamikawa. Since opening, the gallery has built a program centered on dialogue between Japanese and international artists, often through two-person and group exhibitions that pair local and overseas practices. Its roster spans painting, sculpture, photography and collaborative projects, and the gallery has developed long-running relationships with artists such as Shimon Minamikawa, Ken Kagami and Yui Yaegashi. Over nearly two decades it has expanded from local art fairs to a wide international fair circuit and collaborative projects with galleries abroad, while maintaining a small, artist-focused Tokyo space.
